party_self_dpo.name: party_self_dpo
party_self_dpo.value: "party"."kind" <> 'self' OR ("party"."dpo_name" IS NOT NULL AND "party"."dpo_email" IS NOT NULL)

processing_activity_code_prefix.name: processing_activity_code_prefix
processing_activity_code_prefix.value: left("processing_activity"."code", 1) = CASE "processing_activity"."role" WHEN 'controller' THEN 'C' WHEN 'processor' THEN 'P' ELSE 'J' END

processing_activity_controller_fields.name: processing_activity_controller_fields
processing_activity_controller_fields.value: "processing_activity"."role" <> 'controller' OR ("processing_activity"."offering_id" IS NULL AND "processing_activity"."client_coverage" IS NULL AND "processing_activity"."processing_categories" = '{}' AND "processing_activity"."dpia_support_ref" IS NULL)

processing_activity_processor_fields.name: processing_activity_processor_fields
processing_activity_processor_fields.value: "processing_activity"."role" <> 'processor' OR ("processing_activity"."purposes" = '{}' AND "processing_activity"."lawful_bases" = '{}' AND "processing_activity"."special_conditions" = '{}' AND "processing_activity"."dpia_required" IS NULL AND "processing_activity"."dpia_ref" IS NULL)

processing_activity_dates.name: processing_activity_dates
processing_activity_dates.value: "processing_activity"."ended_at" IS NULL OR "processing_activity"."started_at" IS NULL OR "processing_activity"."ended_at" >= "processing_activity"."started_at"

processing_activity_active_controller.name: processing_activity_active_controller
processing_activity_active_controller.value: "processing_activity"."status" <> 'active' OR "processing_activity"."role" <> 'controller' OR (cardinality("processing_activity"."purposes") > 0 AND cardinality("processing_activity"."lawful_bases") > 0 AND "processing_activity"."dpia_required" IS NOT NULL)

processing_activity_active_processor.name: processing_activity_active_processor
processing_activity_active_processor.value: "processing_activity"."status" <> 'active' OR "processing_activity"."role" <> 'processor' OR ("processing_activity"."offering_id" IS NOT NULL AND "processing_activity"."client_coverage" IS NOT NULL AND cardinality("processing_activity"."processing_categories") > 0)
